{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers, completed orders, and exclude QA outliers
loyal_completed_real = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') &
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_real['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Also compute mean revenue including QA outliers for comparison
loyal_completed_with_qa = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed')
]
mean_revenue_with_qa = loyal_completed_with_qa['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output both results
print("Number of LOYAL completed real orders:", len(loyal_completed_real))
print("Mean revenue (USD) excluding QA outliers:", mean_revenue)
print("Mean revenue (USD) including QA outliers:", mean_revenue_with_qa)"}
